## Abstract

The Infrastructure Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to cloud platform strategies, networking architectures, deployment infrastructure, security infrastructure, and operational tooling. This domain provides the foundational technology platform that supports all enterprise applications and services.

Infrastructure architecture decisions directly impact system reliability, scalability, security posture, and operational efficiency across the entire technology landscape.
